transition_semantics: challenger lifecycle DAG: OBSERVED_PATHOLOGY -> UPGRADE_HYPOTHESIS -> PREREGISTERED -> CHALLENGER_IMPLEMENTED -> DEVELOPMENT_VALIDATED -> FRESH_ASSURANCE_PENDING -> {ASSURED|REJECTED|META_OVERFIT|CANNOT_CHECK} -> GOVERNANCE_APPROVED -> PROMOTED -> ACTIVE_PROMOTION_ATTESTED -> MONITORED; rejected variants remain negative history and the prior incumbent stays a rollback target

invention gate precondition: propose a new operator only after axes are flat under the registered window, the residual is route-stable, ordinary causes are excluded, transfer routes are searched or bounded, and explicit evidence supports a representation/method-basis gap

state_ids: four never-collapsed events: code-exists, code-deployed, improvement-supported, governed-incumbent

preregistered proposal packet (frozen before outcomes: parent identity, source episodes/diagnoses, change class A/B/C, predicted meta-QoIs with thresholds, negative controls, hostile near-misses, assurance reserve, rollback plan)
variant DAG with negative history retained

verification_contracts: promotion requires a content-bound certificate issued outside the challenger path, naming exact candidate, assurance verdict, constitution epoch and approving process; a caller-provided approval boolean is declaration-bound and inadmissible

development evaluation exposed to the optimizer is no longer blind: strong claims consume a fresh assurance packet frozen before the challenger and hidden from the proposer, with an explicit exposure budget
evaluator frozen within an evaluation epoch; evaluator changes are separately governed parent mutations at epoch boundaries
